_comment: Passed to each governor seat's Claude Code with --settings (wsp-473). wsp refuses a despawn outside the governor's own list and names the scope it would have needed. `wsp check --set` (wsp-681): wsp refuses it on a row outside the governor's list and logs every change for the verifier; autoMode.allow is the classifier's own rule, which a permission alone does not reach.
_comment_guard: PreToolUse on Bash is the kill guard (wsp-691): wsp-session.sh refuses a pkill, killall or killing pgrep with an option after its first pattern (BSD getopt reads it as one more pattern: on 2026-11-19 `pkill -f "scripts/check.mjs" -P 0` ended every Claude session on the machine), one naming a bare common name (claude, node, wsp, compound-sup, compound-render, cargo), or a pkill pattern under 4 characters, and says to kill by pid. The command runs the script from ~/.claude/hooks, where `wsp install` writes the copy the binary carries (wsp-428), wherever the checkout is; the same text is in every seat's settings and in the snippet, so where both hold it the two are one command and agree; a verifier or plain seat, which has no role file, is started with wsp-seat.settings.json, which holds only this hook.

allow: `wsp check <row> --set --why "…"` by a governor on a row of the list it governs is authorised by Ed: wsp refuses it on any other row and logs every change with its reason where the row's verifier and the barrier read it.
